- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 3–5 day horizons.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes — add 3–7% to forecast if sentiment drops below -0.20 within 3 days.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak if sentiment remains negative or neutral.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 10% above 14-day moving average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was positive 3–5 days prior, forecast should be 1–2% lower than model output.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate by 1–3% in high volatility periods — apply 1.5x smoothing to reduce forecast variance.
